How booking works

Simple, and built so you never pay for a night that doesn't happen.

Step 1

Reserve with 50%

Fill in the reservation form below and pay half the total to lock your spot. We'll confirm your booking on WhatsApp.

Step 2

Balance 7 days before

The remaining half is due a week before your camp — 19 Dec for Christmas, 24 Dec for New Year's Eve.

Step 3

Show up in Mumbai

Meet the group at the pickup point, ride down together, and step onto the sand. Everything after that is on us.

The 30-guest promise

Each camp runs only once 30 guests are fully paid — by 16 Dec for Christmas and 21 Dec for New Year's Eve. If a camp doesn't reach 30, it doesn't run, and every rupee you've paid comes back within 5 working days. No fees held back, no vouchers instead of money.

Good to know

Where exactly is the camp?

On the Alibaug coast (Revdanda–Mandwa side), a short ride from the jetty. The exact beach and Mumbai pickup points are confirmed with your booking, once our campsite partner for each date is locked in.

How does the transport work?

Your price includes Mumbai–Alibaug–Mumbai travel. We pick the group up in Mumbai in the afternoon, and drop everyone back the next day after checkout. Pickup points are shared with confirmed guests.

What should I bring?

Warm layers for later in the night (December on the coast gets cool), comfortable footwear for sand, toiletries, a phone charger or power bank, and any personal medication. Tents, bedding, food and the bonfire are all provided.

Can I get a private tent for two?

Yes — add a private couple tent for ₹499 per tent when you reserve, instead of a shared tent. Pick "Private couple tent" in the form and we'll work out the number of tents from your group size.

What if I need to cancel?

Full refund (minus payment charges) up to the confirmation date — 16 Dec for Christmas, 21 Dec for New Year's Eve. 50% refund after that, and no refund in the final 72 hours. Your spot is transferable to a friend at any time, free.

What if the camp itself is cancelled?

If fewer than 30 guests are fully paid by the confirmation date, the camp doesn't run and everyone is refunded in full within 5 working days. That's the deal, in writing, on every booking.

Who is this for?

Groups of friends, couples and colleagues from Mumbai and Pune who want a festive night out without planning it. You're hosted the whole evening — nobody has to be the organiser.
